title: Setting box model
summary: padding controls the distance between content and border. border can set the width, line style and color of the border at the same time, and border-radius determines the rounded size of the four corners.
tasks: Set 16px padding on all four sides of .card.
sets a solid border of 2px, color #3b7d68, and rounded corners of 12px.
hint: When the card is separated from surrounding elements but the content is still close to the border, check whether margin is written. The space between the content and the border is controlled by padding.
goal: Leave internal space for the training reminder card and surround the content with a rounded border.

example.note: Leave 10px on the top and bottom of the stadium reservation voucher and 14px on the left and right to leave a little more space for the longer reservation number.
